plos-pone-0357180: Sickle cell anemia spills toxic free hemoglobin into the blood. This mouse-model study tested haptoglobin — the body’s natural hemoglobin scavenger — as a therapy. The therapeutic potential it found suggests boosting this cleanup protein could ease the disease’s damage.

plos-pone-0358080: Menopause changes HPV detection patterns and cervical cancer risk in ways screening must account for. plos-pone-0350380: The endangered Orcés’ blue whiptail — a striking Ecuadorian lizard — now has its genome mapped. This paper assembled a highly contiguous reference genome for Holcosus orcesi. The genomic resource gives conservationists the molecular tools to protect a species on the brink.

plos-pone-0355480: Silicon carbide’s promise for power electronics hinges on understanding its Schottky barriers. plos-pone-0356280: Landslide dams — natural walls of debris blocking rivers — can fail catastrophically. plos-pone-0356380: Exclusive breastfeeding for six months saves infant lives — but rates vary widely. plos-pone-0355780: The Great Indian Bustard — critically endangered — needs safe havens mapped now. This paper identified priority conservation areas for the species in India’s Deccan landscape. plos-pone-0356180: Inulin — a prebiotic fiber — might calm oral lichen planus via the gut. plos-pone-0355380: Oxidative stress can cause male infertility — and an African medicinal plant might counter it. plos-pone-0352880: Prisoners’ recidivism connects to how they regulate emotions — in conditional, web-like ways. plos-pone-0354080: Blood clots hold together through molecular cross-linking — and transglutaminase 2 is key. This paper examined its role in stabilizing fibrin clots and supporting hemostasis. europmc-pmc2817680: Genomic cattle breeding relies on estimated breeding values, but combining them across sources is statistically tricky.
